passive.name: Terminating Verdict
passive.text: When an **Ice attribute** equipper uses a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, their **Ice DMG** is increased by **20/23/26/29/32%** for 40s, stacking up to 2 times, once per use of a skill. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. At 2 stacks, the equipper's **Abloom** DMG dealt is increased by an additional **35/38.5/42/45.5/50%**.

passive.name: Data Flood
passive.text:
Increases ATK by **12/15/18/21/24%**.
When using a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by **25/31/37/43/50** for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Energetic Strike
passive.text: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by **90/103/117/130/144**. When the equipper is an **Ether** character, and comes on-field or uses a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG they trigger increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.

passive.name: Data Flood
passive.text:
Increases ATK by **12/15/18/21/24%**.
When using a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by **25/31/37/43/50** for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Kiss of Death
passive.text: When there are enemies inflicted with Attribute Anomaly on the field, the equipper's ATK increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** and they deal an additional **15/17.5/20/22.5/25%** more DMG to the target.

passive.name: Lingering Cries
passive.text: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by **30/34/38/42/48**, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing **Ice DMG**.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient **Trial by Cold**, keep holding Special Attack or Basic Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment**.
Enters the **Bound Absolution** state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.

rows.label: Cloak Slash DMG Per Second Multiplier

entries.name: Basic Attack: Whirling Blade
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the **Bound Absolution** state, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate **Corrosive Chill**.

entries.name: Bound Absolution
entries.text:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing **Ice DMG**. Does not accumulate **Corrosive Chill** upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press Basic Attack or Special Attack during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a **Perfect Dodge** automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.

entries.name: Dodge: Veiled Step
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Grim Reap
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing **Ice DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Soaring Bat
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing **Ice DMG**.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Ambushing Strike
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Injunction
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Intercepting Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing **Ice DMG**.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Execution - Cold Flash
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing **Ice DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the **Bound Absolution** state, dealing **Ice DMG**.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into **EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow**.
Upon use, Promeia gains the **Absolute Order** effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
entries.text:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating **EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death**:
Enters the **Vital View** state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a **Perfect Dodge**, and with enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to consume 40 Energy and activate **EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow**, gaining the **Absolute Order** effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost
entries.text:
While under the **Absolute Order** effect, press Basic Attack or Special Attack while in the **Bound Absolution** state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals **Ice DMG**.
After landing, if Promeia possesses **Trial by Cold**, keep holding Basic Attack or Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost
entries.text:
After triggering **EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow**, press Basic Attack or Special Attack to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals **Ice DMG**.
After landing, if Promeia possesses **Trial by Cold**, keep holding Basic Attack or Special Attack to chain into **EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
entries.text:
With enough **Trial by Cold** and after performing the final hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**, **Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost**, or **Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost**, keep holding Basic Attack or Special Attack after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate **Corrosive Chill**.
After using this skill, hold Basic Attack or Special Attack, or press Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with **Ice Anomaly**, **Ether Anomaly**, **Electric Anomaly**, **Fire Anomaly**, **Physical Anomaly**, or **Wind Anomaly**, it triggers **Abloom** once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with **Ice Anomaly**, **Ether Anomaly**, **Electric Anomaly**, **Fire Anomaly**, **Physical Anomaly**, or **Wind Anomaly**, it triggers **Abloom** once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of **Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Thief of Flames
entries.text:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's **Abloom** DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of **Corrosive Chill** when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger **Freeze**/**Disorder**, when the enemy is inflicted with **Vortex**, or when Promeia triggers **EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow**, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 **Corrosive Chill**, up to a maximum of 100 **Corrosive Chill**.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with **Abloom**, Promeia gains an additional 15 **Corrosive Chill**.
When **Corrosive Chill** reaches at least 50, 50 **Corrosive Chill** is consumed and converted into 1 point of **Trial by Cold**, up to a maximum of 2 points of **Trial by Cold**.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of **Trial by Cold**.
When the finishing move of **EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment** hits an enemy afflicted with **Ice Anomaly**, **Ether Anomaly**, **Electric Anomaly**, **Fire Anomaly**, **Physical Anomaly**, or **Wind Anomaly**, it triggers **Abloom** once, dealing **635%** Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 **Trial by Cold** upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with **Abloom**, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using **Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement** grants **Frost Oath**. With **Frost Oath**, after using **EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment**, **Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment**, or **Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement**, press or hold Special Attack to consume **Frost Oath** and immediately follow up with **Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost**. Only 1 stack of **Frost Oath** can be held.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Vessel of Ice
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Anomaly** or **Support** character:
When using an **EX Special Attack**, Promeia's **Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate** increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the **Frostbite** effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's **EX Special Attack** hits an enemy, it inflicts **Presumption of Guilt**. When any squad member triggers **Abloom** on a target with **Presumption of Guilt**, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. **Presumption of Guilt** lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

entries.name: Innocent Idealism
entries.text:
When Promeia uses **Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement**, she gains an additional effect: if **Trial by Cold** points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of **Trial by Cold**. This effect can trigger once after using **Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement**.
When any squad member triggers **Abloom** on enemies with **Presumption of Guilt**, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.

entries.name: Faltering Conviction
entries.text:
Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40.
The multiplier of **Abloom** triggered by consuming **Trial by Cold** increases by 120%.

entries.name: Cruel Moonlight
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Ruthless Accusation
entries.text: When Promeia triggers **Abloom**, she restores 5 **Corrosive Chill**. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

entries.name: The Dying Moth
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: To Be Continued
entries.text:
When Promeia consumes **Trial by Cold** to trigger **Abloom**, it triggers an additional special **Abloom** effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 **Corrosive Chill** and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s.
In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and **Disorder** DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.
